rationale: C23 plausibly supplied a material administrative template: a central interdepartmental body is established to formulate and coordinate a government-wide program, assist individual departments, disseminate information, recommend improvements, and operate through designated departmental representatives. The child adapts that framework to fair employment, adding a substantially more elaborate complaint-and-appeal system. C14 has some parallel multilevel board and appellate machinery, but it is embedded in a distinct selective-service regulatory system. C03 concerns federal personnel and fairness but supplies little comparable operative structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There shall be established in the Civil Service Commission a Fair Employment Board... [to] Advise all departments... Disseminate information... Coordinate the fair-employment policies and procedures of the several departments.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established the Interdepartmental Committee... [to] Assist the several departments... Act as a clearing house... in the dissemination of such statistics and information... [and] Recommend... methods for improvements in the program.
shared_material.explanation: Both establish a central body whose enumerated functions include departmental assistance, information dissemination, coordination, and program improvement.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The head of each department shall designate an official thereof as Fair Employment Officer... under the immediate supervision of the department head, for carrying out the fair-employment policy herein stated.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Each Committee member shall act as liaison officer between the Committee and his department, establishment, or agency with regard to the said Plan.
shared_material.explanation: Both implement the central program through a specifically responsible representative in each executive department or agency.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The head of each department in the executive branch... shall be personally responsible for an effective program... within his department.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Each of the departments, establishments, and agencies in the executive branch... shall institute and set in operation... the plan of organization and sales promotion recommended by the Committee.
shared_material.explanation: The child follows C23's central-program/decentralized-execution structure, assigning implementation responsibility throughout the executive branch.
